title: Neil deGrasse Tyson Explains How the Periodic Table Works
description:
How did we uncover the elements? Neil deGrasse Tyson and Chuck Nice explain how the periodic table of elements came to be from the discovery of atoms to the way we categorize them to the elements we make in the particle accelerator.
